dynamicworld.requirements: TOA reflectance; B02, B03, B04, B05, B06, B07, B08, B11 and B12 on a 10 m analysis grid.
dynamicworld.limitations: Not Landsat or L2A. Locally exercised on one Sentinel-2A product; this is not an accuracy guarantee for every scene.

prithvi_crop.satellites: Landsat and Sentinel-2 through HLS L30 / S30
prithvi_crop.requirements: Three real HLS acquisition dates, six surface-reflectance bands per date, 18 channels total at 30 m.
prithvi_crop.limitations: Raw Landsat or Sentinel products are not automatically HLS. One date repeated three times is not valid input.

openearthmap.satellites: Very high resolution RGB · e.g. suitable WorldView / Pleiades products; aerial and UAV orthophotos
openearthmap.requirements: Georeferenced RGB with actual 0.25–0.5 m source detail and compatible radiometry.
openearthmap.limitations: Not Sentinel-2 or Landsat. Upsampling coarse imagery does not create the required detail. Validate transfer to your imagery.

prithvi.requirements: BLUE, GREEN, RED, narrow NIR, SWIR1 and SWIR2; mapped physical reflectance and labeled classes. Sentinel-2 NIR uses B8A.
prithvi.limitations: HLS 30 m is the pretrained input domain. This adapter freezes the encoder and trains a downstream head; it does not use a full hyperspectral cube.

ensemble.satellites: Sentinel-2 / Landsat with Prithvi-compatible reflectance bands
ensemble.requirements: The full five-member ensemble needs the six Prithvi bands, labeled classes and compatible member taxonomies/grids.
ensemble.limitations: It inherits its members’ restrictions. Use individual sensor-flexible models for RGB-only or unmapped hyperspectral inputs.

sam3_tracker.satellites: Any sensor with a mapped three-band display composite · Sentinel-2, Landsat, VHR or hyperspectral-derived RGB
sam3_tracker.requirements: Three explicitly selected display bands plus foreground points or a box prompt.
sam3_tracker.limitations: Uses three bands, not the full spectrum. Detail is limited by ground resolution. Proposes boundaries, not LULC classes; human class approval is required.

random_forest.satellites: Sensor-flexible · Sentinel-2, Landsat and mapped hyperspectral GeoTIFFs such as Hyperion, EnMAP or PRISMA
random_forest.requirements: Consistent band identities, units and masks; labeled examples for the sensor and class taxonomy.
random_forest.limitations: A trainable architecture, not a ready pretrained model for every satellite. Sensors without an adapter require prepared local GeoTIFFs; accuracy must be validated.

svm.satellites: Sensor-flexible · Sentinel-2, Landsat and mapped hyperspectral GeoTIFFs such as Hyperion, EnMAP or PRISMA
svm.requirements: Consistent band identities, units and masks; labeled examples for the sensor and class taxonomy.
svm.limitations: A trainable architecture, not a ready pretrained model for every satellite. Sensors without an adapter require prepared local GeoTIFFs; accuracy must be validated.

xgboost.satellites: Sensor-flexible · Sentinel-2, Landsat and mapped hyperspectral GeoTIFFs such as Hyperion, EnMAP or PRISMA
xgboost.requirements: Consistent band identities, units and masks; labeled examples for the sensor and class taxonomy.
xgboost.limitations: A trainable architecture, not a ready pretrained model for every satellite. Sensors without an adapter require prepared local GeoTIFFs; accuracy must be validated.

unet.satellites: Sensor-flexible · Sentinel-2, Landsat and mapped hyperspectral GeoTIFFs such as Hyperion, EnMAP or PRISMA
unet.requirements: Mapped bands and spatial training masks; train or adapt for the sensor, resolution and classes.
unet.limitations: A trainable architecture, not a ready pretrained model for every satellite. Sensors without an adapter require prepared local GeoTIFFs; accuracy must be validated.

rx.satellites: Multispectral / hyperspectral · Sentinel-2, Landsat, Hyperion, EnMAP or PRISMA with mapped local rasters
rx.requirements: All connected science bands on a common grid; meaningful background pixels and consistent calibration.
rx.limitations: Fits background statistics for your dataset. Anomaly scores do not identify a semantic class or establish detection accuracy.

local_rx.satellites: Multispectral / hyperspectral · Sentinel-2, Landsat, Hyperion, EnMAP or PRISMA with mapped local rasters
local_rx.requirements: All connected science bands on a common grid; meaningful background pixels and consistent calibration.
local_rx.limitations: Fits background statistics for your dataset. Anomaly scores do not identify a semantic class or establish detection accuracy.

isolation_forest.satellites: Multispectral / hyperspectral · Sentinel-2, Landsat, Hyperion, EnMAP or PRISMA with mapped local rasters
isolation_forest.requirements: All connected science bands on a common grid; meaningful background pixels and consistent calibration.
isolation_forest.limitations: Fits background statistics for your dataset. Anomaly scores do not identify a semantic class or establish detection accuracy.

autoencoder.satellites: Multispectral / hyperspectral · Sentinel-2, Landsat, Hyperion, EnMAP or PRISMA with mapped local rasters
autoencoder.requirements: All connected science bands on a common grid; meaningful background pixels and consistent calibration.
autoencoder.limitations: Spectral reconstruction model fitted to your background; not a pretrained satellite classifier.
